threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still check the Tube app obsessively, while the rest of us just know it’ll be late. Welcome to the life of 'I'll get there when I get there.'
Caught the N137 last night, and a bloke serenaded us with Abba all the way to Clapham. Only in Brixton, right?

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I saw a guy in a full suit casually ordering a currywurst at 3 a.m. after a night out. Just another Neukölln moment.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: You can find open-air karaoke on the streets of Kreuzberg; it’s like a spontaneous festival where everyone’s a star, even if they can’t sing.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know a local when they know not to trust a bus to be on time, especially with a dog on the tracks or BART falling apart again.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Today, a guy serenaded us on the bus, belting out 'I Will Survive' while a dog in a backpack snoozed. Muni really knows how to keep it quirky.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists often miss that Gràcia's plazas aren't just for lounging; they're actually vibrant community hubs where locals catch up with family and friends.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by the way they still look for sidewalks to walk on, instead of just taking over the street like the locals do.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still look confused when the bus driver yells 'next stop' and nobody gets off. It's a rite of passage we all go through.
Caught the 196 last night, and a woman serenaded the driver with an old Adele track. Whole bus suddenly turned into a concert—only in Brixton!

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I saw a street musician playing the accordion for a group of toddlers dancing on the sidewalk—only in Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Friedrichshain will you spot a hipster café hosting a dog yoga class while a street musician serenades them. Pure Berlin magic.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Only locals know that a 'dog on the tracks' isn't just a Muni delay, but a classic day in the Civic Center chaos. It's a true testament to our 'urban wildlife.'

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the 21 bus today, and it was stopped for 15 minutes because a raccoon was having a snack on the tracks. Just another day in SF.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think we eat paella every day. In Gràcia, it's all about the 'platets' in the local bars, and they’re usually for sharing.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can always tell the newbies by their bright white sneakers—completely unscathed by the dust of Gràcia's cobblestones.
